verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 7

No BC date for Belshazzar's first year; lion = Babylon, bear = Medo-Persia (Persia dominant; ribs = Babylon, Egypt, Lydia), leopard = Greece (four heads = Cassander, Lysimachus, Seleucus, Ptolemy), fourth beast = Rome; ten horns future (ten toes of Dan 2); little horn = future Antichrist from a restored Roman empire (rejects Calvin's Julius Caesar; notes the Adventist papacy view); Ancient of Days = God the Father; son of man = Jesus; time, times, half = 3½ years (Rev 11–13); kingdom received at Jesus' return, on the millennial earth
